title: Editor project parameters
description: Request-only parameters for creating or updating a project. These fields are not part of the stored study metadata document.

idno.title: Unique Identifier
idno.description: Unique identifier for the project. Leave it empty to auto-generate. Study metadata uses the type-specific nested idno (for microdata: study_desc.title_statement.idno).

collection_ids.title: Collection IDs
collection_ids.description: Collections to which the project belongs. e.g. [1, 2]

template_uid.title: Template UID (Unique Identifier)
template_uid.description: Template to be used for the project. If not provided, the default template will be used.
